diff --git a/js/examples/demo/src/sections/RectSection.tsx b/js/examples/demo/src/sections/RectSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e16b86a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/js/examples/demo/src/sections/RectSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+import { Rect, Stack, useTheme, type Theme } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
+import React from "react";
+import { Label, Section } from "../ui";
+
+const SWATCHES = [
+  "primary",
+  "accent",
+  "success",
+  "warning",
+  "danger",
+  "surface",
+  "surfaceAlt",
+  "outline",
+] as const satisfies ReadonlyArray<keyof Theme>;
+
+export function RectSection() {
+  const { theme } = useTheme();
+  return (
+    <Section
+      title="Screen, theme and Rect"
+      blurb="Screen fills the 960×544 display with theme.background. Rect draws a fill or an outline with any borderRadius, and useTheme() hands out the palette."
+    >
+      <Stack direction="row" gap={16} align="center">
+        <Rect width={96} height={64} color={theme.primary} />
+        <Rect width={96} height={64} color={theme.primary} borderRadius={12} />
+        <Rect width={96} height={64} variant="outline" color={theme.accent} />
+        <Rect width={96} height={64} variant="outline" color={theme.accent} borderRadius={24} />
+        <Rect width={96} height={64} color={theme.surface} borderColor={theme.success} borderRadius={8} />
+        <Rect width={64} height={64} color={theme.warning} borderRadius={32} />
+      </Stack>
+      <Label fontSize={13} color={theme.outline}>
+        fill · fill r=12 · outline · outline r=24 · fill + borderColor · circle (r = half the size)
+      </Label>
+      <Stack direction="row" gap={8}>
+        {SWATCHES.map((name) => (
+          <Stack key={name} gap={4} align="center">
+            <Rect width={76} height={40} color={theme[name]} borderColor={theme.outline} borderRadius={6} />
+            <Label width={76} fontSize={12} align="center">
+              {name}
+            </Label>
+          </Stack>
+        ))}
+      </Stack>
+    </Section>
+  );
+}

diff --git a/js/examples/demo/src/sections/TextSection.tsx b/js/examples/demo/src/sections/TextSection.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fb15d43
--- /dev/null
+++ b/js/examples/demo/src/sections/TextSection.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import { Rect, Stack, useTheme } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
+import React from "react";
+import { CONTENT_WIDTH, Label, Section } from "../ui";
+
+const ALIGNS = ["left", "center", "right"] as const;
+
+export function TextSection() {
+  const { theme } = useTheme();
+  return (
+    <Section
+      title="Text"
+      blurb="UTF-8 text with align, word wrap, lineHeight, any fontSize and declared Deck App Fonts."
+      blurbLines={1}
+    >
+      <Stack direction="row" gap={10}>
+        {ALIGNS.map((align) => (
+          <Rect key={align} width={220} height={28} variant="outline" color={theme.outline} borderRadius={4}>
+            <Label x={8} y={4} width={204} align={align}>{`align="${align}"`}</Label>
+          </Rect>
+        ))}
+      </Stack>
+      <Label fontSize={14} lines={2}>
+        {
+          'wrap="word" breaks long lines at spaces inside width, and lineHeight sets the distance between them. This sentence is long enough to need a second line.'
+        }
+      </Label>
+      <Stack direction="row" gap={16} align="end">
+        {[12, 16, 24, 32].map((size) => (
+          <Label key={size} width={size * 3} fontSize={size}>{`${size}px`}</Label>
+        ))}
+        <Label width={300} fontSize={18} font="mono" color={theme.success}>
+          {'font="mono" 0O1lI {} =>'}
+        </Label>
+      </Stack>
+      <Label fontSize={20}>Árvíztűrő tükörfúrógép</Label>
+      <Label fontSize={22}>Emoji: 🎮 🚀 🎉 👍🏽 🇭🇺 ❤️</Label>
+      <Stack direction="row" gap={12} align="center">
+        <Label width={200} fontSize={20}>
+          日本語 中文 한국어
+        </Label>
+        <Label width={CONTENT_WIDTH - 212} fontSize={13} color={theme.outline}>
+          Korean renders as boxes until #95 lands.
+        </Label>
+      </Stack>
+    </Section>
+  );
+}

+          <Rect width={120} height={28} color={theme.accent} borderRadius={4} />
+          <Rect width={120} height={28} color={theme.accent} borderRadius={4} />
+        </Stack>
+        <Stack direction="row" gap={4} padding={6} color={theme.surfaceAlt}>
+          <Rect width={28} height={28} color={theme.success} borderRadius={14} />

+          <Rect width={28} height={28} color={theme.success} borderRadius={14} />

+        <Label width={250} fontSize={13} lines={3} color={theme.outline}>

+        </Label>
+      </Stack>
+    </Section>
+  );
+}
